Historical four-test checkpoint: 16 synthetic groups, explicit-flush/SIGKILL, copied-metadata corruption and clean narrow-fixture reopen. Later 15-test and 20-test coverage is recorded separately; this entry does not establish full-text ENOSPC recovery.
Combined Rust types, native PG17.11 bindings and cshim compile. Linking and installation are separate gates.
Private fault feature compiles. No fault experiment outcome is implied.
Exact matching published CLI installed in locked mode and version checked.
PostgreSQL17.11 extension cdylib linked with pgrx0.19.3 and Edge0.8.0. Installation and SQL runtime remain separate gates.
Matching CLI discovers9 SQL entities: 2 schemas, 6 functions and final privilege block. Generated SQL inspected.
Shared library, control file and SQL installed into PG17.11. CREATE EXTENSION and actual SQL are separately recorded in postgres_runtime evidence.
Private-feature shared library linked and 7-function SQL generated. The normal 6-function schema excludes the fault entry point. Runtime results are recorded separately.
10 normal-profile SQL checks in non-root PostgreSQL17.11, including real 16-group Edge smoke. Private diagnostic permissions do not prove source-table or RLS authorization.

12 private-fault checks measured caught-panic survival and companion SQL session termination after direct-worker SIGKILL/native abort. Committed PostgreSQL marker survived. This is evidence against the direct-worker isolation boundary.

Both helper normal and private-fault profiles linked and generated SQL (6 and 7 functions). Direct profiles also regenerated. This local evidence is separate from the subsequent recorded helper PostgreSQL runtime.

7 normal and 8 private-fault standalone pipe/process checks after matching locked builds, including actual Edge execution and pure-controller SIGKILL cleanup. Not PostgreSQL failure-containment evidence. Historical local controller-SIGKILL cleanup cannot independently prove the gate because live PID visibility was not required before the kill. Current guarded local normal/private reruns each pass six checks then fail that precondition before sending SIGKILL; CI2 remains separate observed evidence.
10 normal helper PostgreSQL checks and 7 standalone protocol checks passed. Overall workflow failed separately at the positive ENOSPC experiment.

15 private helper PostgreSQL checks and 8 standalone protocol checks passed. Helper SIGKILL/abort preserved companion SQL; the actual 125-second operation limit, supervisor SIGTERM cleanup and four-start/three-restart exhaustion were observed. No native cancellation, actual OOM or complete product claim.

Attempted only in the dedicated 32 MiB tmpfs container. No JSON report returned; original wrapper did not preserve the exit code or signal, so exact cause and recovery remain unverified. A corrected probe must repeat this test.

Dedicated 32 MiB tmpfs filled, then the NamedTempFile error wrapper hid raw errno 28. Config save and recovery were not reached; all four PostgreSQL runtime profiles were skipped after the early failed gate. The owned-File correction requires another complete CI run.

Dedicated 32 MiB vector/keyword fixture: real ENOSPC configuration-save failure, unchanged persisted bytes, filler cleanup, retry, explicit flush and reopen with eight rows/four representations and keyword/tenant/MaxSim queries. Both mutable text indexes excluded; no full-text, dirty-ingestion, PostgreSQL atomicity or OOM claim.

Direct normal/private SQL 10/12, normal-helper SQL 10 and normal helper pipes 7 passed. Overall workflow failed: private helper pipes passed six checks then raised ESRCH during controller-SIGKILL cleanup observation; private native-abort and private-helper SQL were not reached.

Historical integrated 15-test local suite: zero failed/ignored. Source hashes are recorded in the engine evidence. Advanced queries, lifecycle and dynamic schemas add engine feasibility coverage; no product completion or current PostgreSQL runtime claim.
Two actual-child tests using the private production module. Complete local pipe suites fail their live-PID visibility precondition; current SQL runtime requires CI.

Base image/extension install, 15 engine tests, 2 real-child tests, 6 Python diagnostics and narrow 32 MiB ENOSPC passed. Full-text 128 MiB terminated with SIGBUS at recovery_reopen; all four PostgreSQL profiles were skipped. No full-text recovery, current SQL or P0 exit claim.
20 local engine tests passed with no failures or ignored tests; final fault-assertion diagnostic changes are checked separately. Synthetic fixtures only; no SQL or complete product claim.

Corrected candidate-format source compiles against PG17.11. The earlier linked iteration is separately identified; all three new SQL assertion groups were pending at this local checkpoint. Their later four-profile runtime success is recorded in the CI6 entry below.

All four images installed and SQL groups 13/15/13/19 plus helper pipes 7/8 passed;20 engine,2 child,9 Python and narrow32 MiB ENOSPC passed. Overall workflow failed: full-text128 MiB fault and no-filler clean reopen both SIGBUS with all mount capacity allocated. No dirty recovery, OOM, P0 exit or later-source runtime claim.

Three candidate-format groups passed in all four SQL profiles, including signed-zero bit evidence, finite float32 extremes, shape/budget/null rejection and ACL/runtime-superuser checks. Backend-only serialization; no public API freeze or source-recheck claim.

All four locked Linux x86_64 metadata profiles resolve 440 packages with unchanged registry coordinates/checksums; private Edge probe adds only an optional direct edge to already locked libc 0.2.189. Resolution is not linking or runtime evidence.

Recorded integration snapshot passes 23 normal engine tests, 3 private native OOM guard tests, 21 Python tests, all 4 extension compile profiles and both helper binary compile profiles. No new local link/install, SQL, dedicated fault mount or positive OOM execution; no P0/release claim.

All four images build and install. SQL 19/21/19/25, helper pipes 7/8, 23 normal engine, two child and 21 Python tests pass. Original six source-recheck and three format groups pass per SQL profile. Narrow 32 MiB and full-text 384 MiB ENOSPC/reopen, a separate clean reopen and exact 128 MiB zero-write refusal pass. Both exact kernel OOM attributions pass; direct-worker containment fails and helper containment passes for the controlled experiment. The artifact digest and all 53 members are independently verified. Later source is excluded; production authorization, atomicity, P0 exit and release remain unverified.

Exact recorded source passes 43 concrete Edge method call bodies, 25 ordinary engine tests and four PostgreSQL compile profiles. Invalid-input behavior requires adapter validation; dirty-generation reconstruction uses a complete synthetic source. The seventh inside-SPI SQL group and heap-only restriction compile but are not runtime-verified. Later native/CPU changes are excluded.

The independent workspace pins Tantivy 0.26.2 with its own lockfile and 109 selected Linux packages. Five small primitive cases pass, with fuzzy budget, phrase/array, snippet and reader/update limitations retained. No core adoption, analyzer parity, held-out quality, SQL integration or release claim.

Exact source hashes pass local CPU admission, 27 ordinary engine tests (including two pure CPU policy tests), all four PostgreSQL compile profiles and both helper compile profiles. Actual local native objects pass the scoped HLE/RTM and AVX-512 audit. A mismatched historical saved compile log is retained but excluded; its verified fresh repeat passed. Revised clean native installation and current SQL/runtime remain pending.

All four frozen-input diagnostic images built and installed. 27 ordinary engine, two child, 38 Python, SQL 20/22/20/26, helper pipes 7/8, four disk/capacity cases and both exact kernel OOM comparisons passed. The three private allocator guard tests passed in each private build. Direct-worker containment remains a negative finding; production source indexing, authorization, atomicity and release support are not established.

Clean TLS/bootstrap and authenticated frozen APT installation passed; every profile matches 246 installed package/version entries and seven exact PGDG archive pins. Tool/PG/ELF reports and all 246 copyright hashes were collected; 125 packages have parsed labels and 121 explicit parsing gaps remain. No bit-identical binaries, full loader closure, exact libclang path or distribution clearance.

All four image profiles admit the 20 required usable features and report identical audited SSE/AVX2 object hashes under GCC 13.3.0/objdump 2.42. Scoped audit observes no HLE/RTM instructions or AVX-512 register operands; it is not complete dependency ISA or unsupported-hardware execution proof.

Five isolated Tantivy 0.26.2 primitive cases passed in the separate 512 MiB, one-CPU, 64-PID, 45-second container. Independent 109-package locked graph remains outside the core dependency graph; fuzzy budgets, field/phrase/snippet behavior and quality/lifecycle limitations remain. No lexical adapter adoption or F13-F20 completion.
